draw.check.ctx: Right-click menu row on an atom with a check observation; it opens the three parts. {what} = the problem in one sentence.
draw.check.found: Status of the drawing check; {n} = number of observations found.
draw.check.fail: Status when the drawing check does not start; {message} = error message.
draw.check.atoms: Atoms an observation refers to; {list} = symbol and number of the atoms, e.g. "C1, N7".
draw.check.valence.what: Valence problem; {el} = element symbol, {valence} = bonds counted (H included), {allowed} = allowed valences separated by /.
draw.check.valenceCharge.what: Valence that does not match the charge; {el} = element symbol, {valence} = bonds counted.
draw.check.valenceCharge.next: Next step; {fix} = the charge (e.g. +1) that would make the valence right.
draw.check.charge.what: Unusual charge; {q} = signed charge (e.g. +2), {el} = element symbol.
draw.check.isotope.what: Unknown isotope; {iso} = mass number written, {el} = element symbol.
draw.check.pieces.what: Note about separate pieces; {n} = number of structures not bonded to each other.
error.check.tooBig: Drawing check error; {max} = maximum number of atoms.
